newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Forest blaze kills 14 in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Forest blaze kills 14 in Russia.

text.p: Fourteen people died trying to extinguish a forest fire near Russia's border with Kazakhstan, an emergencies ministry spokesman said on Sunday.

Itar-Tass news agency said lightning had sparked the fire in Uglovskoye district in southern Russia on Saturday and that a fire station chief, a driver and 12 local inhabitants had been sent to tackle the blaze.
The emergencies ministry spokesman said he could not confirm what had started the fire or who the victims were.
"Investigations are still going on and we do not yet have any details," he said by telephone.
